name: Travel Times
description: Door-to-door times by CTA/transit, Uber, Lyft and car, with estimated ride prices, for saved routes and upcoming calendar events. Color-coded by who each trip is for.
author: Ryan

routes.title: Saved routes
routes.description: Common trips like Work or School. Each one is shown with a time for every travel mode turned on below.

person.title: Who it's for
person.description: A family member's name, as entered in Settings > Family. Their color and name tag the route. Leave blank for everyone.

origin.title: From
origin.description: An address, place name, or "lat,lon". Blank uses the home address under Calendar.

days.title: Show on
days.description: None picked shows it every day.

activeFrom.title: Show from
activeFrom.description: Optional. With Show until, limits the route to part of the day, e.g. 06:00 to 10:00 for a morning commute. Times are only looked up while the route is showing.

showTransit.title: Public transit
showTransit.description: Trains and buses from Google Maps, including the walk to and from the stop.

showRideshare.title: Uber and Lyft estimates
showRideshare.description: Estimated door-to-door time (a wait for the car plus the drive) and price, from Ridewise's published rate cards. No Uber or Lyft account needed.

rideshareWait.title: Wait for a car (minutes)
rideshareWait.description: Added to the drive time for the Uber and Lyft estimates. 5 is typical in a city.

rateRegion.title: Price region
rateRegion.description: A Ridewise region name such as "Chicago Metro" or "NYC Metro". Blank picks the nearest to home, or US Default.

rushSurge.title: Rush-hour pricing
rushSurge.description: Raise estimated prices on weekdays 7:00-9:30 and 16:00-19:00 (half as much for the half hour either side) and Friday/Saturday 22:00-03:00. A rough guess, not live surge.

showUber.title: Uber (live quotes)
showUber.description: Real Uber quotes in place of the estimate. Only works once Uber approves your developer app for ride estimates; see the README.

uberProduct.title: Uber ride type
uberProduct.description: As Uber names it: UberX, Comfort, UberXL, Black...

showLyft.title: Lyft (live quotes)
showLyft.description: Real Lyft quotes in place of the estimate. Needs Lyft API credentials; see the README.

showCalendar.title: Upcoming events
showCalendar.description: Travel times to the next calendar events that have a location.

homeAddress.title: Home address
homeAddress.description: Where trips to events start from, and the start of any route left blank. Event distance is measured from the household location in Settings, or from this address if none is set.

rideshareHours.title: Uber/Lyft for events starting within (hours)
rideshareHours.description: Ride prices and pickup times are only good for now, so later events show transit and drive times only.

bufferMinutes.title: Arrive early by (minutes)
bufferMinutes.description: Added to the "leave by" time for events.

eventFilter.title: Skip events whose title contains
eventFilter.description: Comma-separated, e.g. "Zoom, Teams, WFH". Events with a link instead of an address are always skipped.

scaleWithSize.title: Scale with module size
scaleWithSize.description: Grow text, logos and numbers with the module, so a large module stays readable from across the room. Text size still applies on top. Off sizes everything from Text size alone.

refreshMinutes.title: Check times every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: Each check of a route is 2 Google requests (transit and drive). Nearby calendar events are checked once 3 hours before they start, then on this schedule from 90 minutes before.

monthlyCap.title: Google requests per month (hard limit)
monthlyCap.description: Lookups stop for the rest of the calendar month once this many Google requests have been sent from this display. Counted per display.

alertPercent.title: Warn at (% of monthly limit)
alertPercent.description: Shows a notice on the module, and writes a warning to the Home Screens log.

quietFrom.title: Pause lookups from
quietFrom.description: No requests between these times, to save API calls overnight. Clear both to never pause.

secrets.label: Google Maps API key
secrets.description: Google Cloud key with the Routes API enabled. The same key the built-in Traffic module uses works here.

secrets.label: Uber Client ID (optional)
secrets.description: Only for an Uber app that Uber has approved for ride estimates. Leave blank otherwise.

secrets.label: Lyft client credentials (optional)
secrets.description: Your Lyft client ID and secret joined as "id:secret" and base64-encoded. See the README for the one-line command.
